claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, currently on PSV 5 cmH2O with FiO2 50%, and reassess readiness for weaning/spontaneous breathing trial.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly or per-protocol glucose monitoring to maintain glucose in target range (recent fingersticks 89-125 mg/dL).
Monitor hemodynamics and continue vasopressor support with phenylephrine drip, titrating to maintain MAP goals given recent MAP 71-81 mmHg and CVP 9-10 mmHg.
Monitor and manage temporary pacemaker settings (rate 50 bpm, atrial and ventricular sensing/stimulation thresholds) and cardiac rhythm with ST-segment monitoring.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess oxygenation and ventilation, given FiO2 50%, pO2 140 mmHg, pCO2 36 mmHg, and pH 7.37.
Perform delirium screening (CAM-ICU) and maintain reorientation, sleep hygiene, and early mobility to address prior positive CAM-ICU and current RASS 0.
Continue analgesia with acetaminophen and opioids as needed, reassessing pain (recent pain scores 3-6) and sedation goal RASS 0.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis and monitor coagulation parameters (INR 1.1-1.4, PTT 26.5-30.7 sec, platelets 144-162 K/uL).
Monitor electrolytes and renal function, including potassium (4.3-5.5 mEq/L), magnesium 2.6 mg/dL, creatinine 1.2-1.3 mg/dL, and BUN 20-21 mg/dL, and replace electrolytes as needed.
Continue antimicrobial therapy with cefazolin and vancomycin, and monitor for signs of infection with serial CBC (WBC 10.6-19.4 K/uL) and cultures as indicated.
